design.cohort: Same people complete on all expanded-panel fields at all recording occasions; report exclusions and all-row coverage separately.
design.occasions: Source row order only. Not disease stages, calendar-aligned visits, stable baselines, or equal time intervals.
design.resampling: Resample whole participants with replacement using the same draws for both panels and every occasion. Never bootstrap 240 rows as independent people.
design.networks: Signed Pearson correlations across participants at each recording occasion. Descriptive only: population differences and acquisition factors can drive associations.
design.dimension: Participation ratio p^2 / sum(R^2) for a standardized correlation matrix. Not a biological variable count or a test of DNB sufficiency.
design.intervals: Pointwise participant-bootstrap percentile intervals, not simultaneous significance tests. 1000 draws are a computational precision setting, not an optimized prediction parameter.
design.clock_times: Retain valid clock observations; exclude from linear Pearson panels to avoid midnight discontinuities and unverified calendar alignment.
design.other_exclusions: Identifiers/age/sex are metadata; exercise type is categorical; nap count, late-night flag, smoking level and 1-5 self-rating require discrete/ordinal sensitivity designs. Retain time in bed but do not add another closely related sleep-duration measure to this initial comparison.
design.missingness: No imputation or winsorization. Out-of-scale and explicitly questioned cells are withheld from analysis but raw cells are preserved. Compare raw questioned numeric value as a separate sensitivity check, never as a correction.
design.selection: Panels specified by measurement domains before network calculation; no best-panel selection, module discovery, p-value gates or warning thresholds.
design.readiness: No actual event/onset, stable-reference labels, full calendar timestamps or continuous daily records supplied. Warning accuracy, lead time and clinical DNB transition claims remain unavailable.
